subject_runtime: Each case ran in an isolated task with the frozen package entry point and only task-relevant package-relative resources available. Subjects were instructed not to inspect evals, verification, development, distribution copies, or prior outputs. Browsing, connected sources, durable state, and external actions were unavailable.

case_runtime_overrides.S-HIGH-STAKES-001: No current legal authority was available.
case_runtime_overrides.S-STATE-001: No file write or analytics capability was available.

capture_method: Subject responses returned by isolated collaboration agents and copied verbatim into this run by the root agent.
evidence_boundary: Manual subject evidence for package transfer under the named model and supplied conditions. It is not shared-testbed execution, plugin installation, discovery, invocation, Claude-host behavior, legal clearance, or release approval.
